details.about: Samsung Austin Semiconductor, part of Samsung's advanced semiconductor business, is hiring a Cyber Security Engineer to put in place and maintain its cybersecurity infrastructure and to run the systems that monitor, detect and respond to security incidents.
duties: Detect threats early: analyse security events, detection engineering and threat hunting
Investigate incidents: validate alerts, classify them (malware, phishing, ransomware, insider threat), set severity and scope, and escalate high-priority cases
Monitor and manage alerts across endpoints, servers, Active Directory, network devices, AWS, Azure and Google Cloud, Kubernetes, SaaS apps, databases, VPN and email security
Respond to incidents with SOC, IT infrastructure, cloud, networking, legal and business teams
Write and maintain security documentation for operations, incident response and compliance
Secure removable media: scanning policies, blocking unauthorized USB devices and keeping an inventory of approved encrypted devices
needs: Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science or a related field
2+ years of experience in cyber security
Experience in, or eagerness to learn, networking, Linux and Windows Server administration
details.benefits: Base salary $76,000 – $110,000 a year; individual pay depends on duties, location, education, skills and experience. Total compensation includes a benefits package and may include company incentive programs; eligible full-time employees may receive MBO bonuses. Benefits include medical, dental and vision insurance, life insurance, 401(k) matching with immediate vesting, onsite cafés and workout facilities, paid maternity and paternity leave, paid time off plus 2 personal holidays and 10 regular holidays, and wellness incentives.
notes: All positions at Samsung Austin Semiconductor are full-time on-site

yt_title: Samsung Is Hiring: Cyber Security Engineer | Austin, TX | $76K–$110K

scenes.head: The role
lines: Now hiring in Austin, Texas! Samsung Austin Semiconductor wants a Cyber Security Engineer to help protect its systems from cyber threats.

scenes.head: What you'll do
bullets: Monitor alerts on endpoints, cloud & network
lines: You'll spot threats early, investigate alerts, and decide which ones are real incidents.
You'll monitor everything from laptops and servers to cloud platforms, and help respond when something goes wrong.

scenes.head: What you need
bullets: Bachelor's in cybersecurity, CS or related
Networking, Linux & Windows Server (or eager to learn)
lines: You'll need a bachelor's in cybersecurity or computer science, two years of cyber security experience, and networking, Linux, and Windows Server skills, or the drive to learn them.
show: You'll need a bachelor's in cybersecurity or computer science, 2 years of cyber security experience, and networking, Linux, and Windows Server skills, or the drive to learn them.

scenes.head: Pay
lines: Base pay is seventy-six thousand to one hundred ten thousand dollars a year, with a four-oh-one-k match that vests right away, health cover, and paid time off with twelve holidays.
show: Base pay is $76,000 to $110,000 a year, with a 401(k) match that vests right away, health cover, and paid time off with 12 holidays.
